rules.statement: In an action under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code, it is open to either party to prove possession as presumptive evidence of title, and thus shift the burden of displacing the presumption on to the other side.
rules.supporting_quote: it is, nevertheless, open to either party to prove possession as presumptive evidence of title, and, thus shift the burden of displacing the presumption on to the other side.
